intro: Short version of what I do when I am not working.

items.title: Electronic music
items.body: Melodic house and techno, mostly while working or on a plane. I keep a playlist that I actually update.

items.title: Staying active
items.body: Yoga in the morning, gym when the week allows it. It is the only reliable way I stay sane on the road.

items.title: Startups, VC and AI
items.body: I read about them for work and then keep reading on the weekend, which probably says something.

items.title: Travel
items.body: I like the first 48 hours in a new city, when you still have no idea how anything works.
